proposal.reason: Main change is CE/OKI DMA execution policy: src/init.cc reassigns OKI QP/ring IDs (reserve ring 0, move local/remote queue mapping) and enables OKI only when rank-wide feature bits match, while src/ce_coll.cc switches CE batch launch to OKI-ring mode and adds stream channel hinting behavior for memcpy/capture. This is copy-engine-owned queue/stream partitioning and DMA synchronization behavior; enqueue.cc and peerInfo plumbing are supporting wiring for that same CE/OKI path, not an independent module contract change.
